item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: {"rule":"The procedure appears to force the ace of spades: if the first tapped pair contains it, that pair remains; otherwise the pair is discarded. Of the final two cards, tapping the ace of spades keeps it, while tapping the other card discards that card."}
